newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China plans London merchant bank.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China plans London merchant bank.

text.p: The Bank of China plans to set up a merchant bank subsidiary in London, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The merchant bank, Bank of China International (UK) Limited, would be formed under a holding company, the Bank of China International Holdings, and would start operation by the end of this year, Xinhua said.
Wang Xuebing, Bank of China president and chairman, would act as chairman of the new holding company and British national Brian Woolley would serve as managing director of the merchant bank.
Bank of China International (UK) would aim at providing corporate advisory services to European businesses seeking investments in China, it said without giving further details.
